image.title: Sand roasted peanuts in Kerala
image.author: Vis M
image.facesSignsPlates: No face; vendor's torso/hand at top (90-560,0-245). Red shop signboard with brand name 'JOS ALUKKAS' (jeweller) at top right (555-960,0-90). Packaged-goods bag with brand label at top left (0-250,80-240).
image.notes: Shows the act itself (shelled peanuts roasting in hot sand in a kadai on a cart). Paper cones not visible; South India rather than the north. Companion 'Sand roasted peanuts in Kerala 02.jpg' (same author/licence) shows the vendor sieving sand off the peanuts.

searched: Commons (EN 'roasted peanuts vendor India', 'peanut seller', 'groundnut vendor', 'sand roasted', HI 'मूंगफली', incategory Peanut_vendors), Openverse, Flickr free-licence ('peanut roasting sand', 'roasted peanuts india street', 'peanut seller delhi', 'मूंगफली', 'peanut vendor india', 'peanuts paper cone india').
notes: No free photo of north-Indian sand/salt roasting with newspaper cones found; this Kerala cart is the clearest image of the roasting itself.

image.title: Euerfotograf Taj Mahal ('Taj Mahal, India, during a monsoon downpour')
image.author: Hendrik Mallmann (User:Hendrikm2)
image.license: CC BY 3.0 (dual-licensed with GFDL; use CC BY 3.0)
image.place: Taj Mahal, Agra - south side of the central raised marble tank (Category:South side of the Taj Mahal Tomb with the pool)
image.facesSignsPlates: Only small distant visitors (about 230-400,325-355 and 750-790,325-355); no readable faces. No signs. Embedded EXIF copyright 'HENDRIK MALLMANN www.euerfotograf.de' (metadata only, no visible watermark).
image.notes: This is the bench on the south edge of the central raised platform, i.e. the spot of Diana's 1992 photo (Flickr 'On the famous Taj Mahal bench' by lisa bat confirms the same bench/pool, but has faces). Small original (1000 px). Uploader is the photographer himself (username matches EXIF name); a professional, so flag for a quick check. Monsoon haze makes the Taj pale.

image.title: Red Fort, Delhi4
image.author: Andrew Moore (Flickr: andryn2006)

altJa: 1914年のベデカー旅行案内書のジャイプル地図。左上の市街中心図では、まっすぐな大通りで町がいくつもの四角い区画（チャウクリ）に分けられている。

image.title: Jaipur 1914 (from Baedeker, 'Indien: Handbuch für Reisende', 1914)
image.author: Karl Baedeker, Leipzig (map engraved by Wagner & Debes, Leipzig)
image.facesSignsPlates: None (map). Printer's imprint 'Wagner & Debes, Leipzig' bottom right.
image.suggestedCrop: 40,30,650,970 (the inset 'JAIPUR (Centre of the City) 1:25,000'); for a square: 40,330,650,650
image.notes: The inset shows the walled city's straight streets and rectangular wards (Ramchandar, Modikhana, Biseshar ji, Ghat Chaukri, Purani Basti, the Palace) - the grid itself. The lower main map also shows the walled city among hills. Text is English/German place names.

searched: Commons Category:Maps of Jaipur (6 files), Flickr free-licence ('jaipur map', 'jaipur aerial'; candidates: SEDAC Landsat image - grid not visible; photo of a hotel-association tourist map board - poster with photos, not usable).

photoNoteJa: 写真は、色の光で照らされたレッド・フォートの建物（2011年）
altJa: 夜のレッド・フォートの建物が、青・緑・赤の光でアーチを照らされている。
searched: Commons (search 'Red Fort' + 'light show', 'sound and light', 'light and sound', 'son et lumiere'; 5 image files found and viewed), Flickr free-licence ('red fort sound and light', 'red fort light show').
notes: The current file IS the show: its Commons description is 'light and sound show at the Red Fort' (Diwan-i-Khas lit in colours, 8 Oct 2011, 3.2 s exposure). The other Commons files ('Music and Light Show Red Fort.jpg', '... Red Fort Delhi.jpg', 'Music and Light Show.jpg', 'Light & Sound Show.jpg') show the same Diwan-i-Khas lit in red/blue during the show - none is clearer, and none shows the actors or projections mentioned in the line (newer show). Possible photo-note fix: the image does show the show, so the note could become e.g. 「写真は、2011年のショーで照らされたディーワーネ・ハースの建物」 or be dropped.
